SELECT 
    i_item_id, 
    i_item_desc, 
    s_store_id, 
    s_store_name,
    MAX(ss_net_profit) AS store_sales_profit,
    COALESCE(MAX(sr_net_loss), 0) AS store_returns_loss,
    COALESCE(MAX(cs_net_profit), 0) AS catalog_sales_profit
FROM 
    (SELECT i_item_id, s_store_id, ss_net_profit FROM store_sales WHERE d_moy = 4 AND d_year = 1999 GROUP BY i_item_id, s_store_id) fss
LEFT JOIN 
    (SELECT sr_item_sk, MAX(sr_net_loss) AS store_returns_loss FROM store_returns WHERE d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10 AND d_year = 1999 GROUP BY sr_item_sk) fsr ON fss.i_item_id = fsr.sr_item_sk
LEFT JOIN 
    (SELECT cs_item_sk, MAX(cs_net_profit) AS catalog_sales_profit FROM catalog_sales WHERE d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10 AND d_year = 1999 GROUP BY cs_item_sk) fcs ON fss.i_item_id = fcs.cs_item_sk
JOIN 
    item ON fss.i_item_id = item.i_item_sk
JOIN 
    store ON fss.s_store_id = store.s_store_sk
GROUP BY 
    i_item_id, 
    i_item_desc, 
    s_store_id, 
    s_store_name
ORDER BY 
    i_item_id, 
    i_item_desc, 
    s_store_id, 
    s_store_name
LIMIT 100
